comments.author: KappaCam
comments.body_html:
Whilst you can do this, I don’t recommend it as it can mess with a lot of stuff and isn’t practical.

Unsnap from the player, press F10, and change the attach type to “lock” (for newer versions, this attach type will be in the F12 menu, and called “parented”), then move the camera into the players head. When the text in the middle of the screen has “Neck” in it, then press F6. Angle the camera to where you want, set the FOV and press the “Switch camera control to mouse” button (default is equals) to lock the mouse movement of the camera and not the player.

This will cause a lot of head bouncing.

comments.author: KappaCam
comments.body_html:
Hey! Yep it’s possible.

Make sure you update to the latest version as this has changed now.

Attach the camera to the player by looking at the player (make sure that the text in the middle of the screen says “Player(C” (or something similar), and press F6. Press F12 and scroll down to the utility section. Change the attachtype to “parented”. Move around the camera to a position you are happy with, then press Equals to lock the camera’s mouse. Then you can move the player around, and the camera will be parented to the player.
